'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Islamist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**[[Islamism|Islamist]] militant group [[Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal-Muslimin]] claims it killed 200 [[Burkina Faso Armed Forces|soldiers]] in an attack on a military base on Sunday in [[Djibo]], [[Sahel]], [[Burkina Faso]]. They also claimed responsibility for the [[2025 Diapaga attack|Diapaga attack]] this week at a military post in [[Loroum Province]] that killed 60 soldiers. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/15/al-qaeda-affiliate-claims-200-soldiers-killed-in-attack-in-burkina-faso (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Papua conflict]]
**The [[Indonesian military]] confirms that 18 [[Free Papuan Movement|Papuan separatists]] and three civilians were killed in yesterday's [[military operation]] in [[Intan Jaya Regency]], [[Central Papua]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-military-says-18-separatists-killed-operation-papua-region-2025-05-15/ (Reuters)] [https://news.detik.com/berita/d-7915110/tni-tembak-mati-18-anggota-opm-di-intan-jaya-papua-tengah/ (detikcom)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*A long-lost version of the [[United Kingdom|British]] [[Magna Carta]], dating to [[1300]] in the reign of [[King of England|King]] [[Edward I]], is believed to have been found at [[Harvard University]] in the [[United States]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cm23zjknre7o (BBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2025/may/15/harvards-unofficial-copy-of-magna-carta-is-actually-an-original-experts-say (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Canadian wildfires]]
**Two people are killed and more than 1,000 others evacuate after [[wildfire]]s spread across central [[Manitoba]], [[Canada]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2025/05/16/police-say-two-people-were-killed-in-massive-wildfire-in-central-canadian-province-of-mani (Euronews)]
*[[Bayesian (yacht)#Sinking|Sinking of the ''Bayesian'']]
**British investigators say the cause of the sinking of the [[Bayesian (yacht)|''Bayesian'']] [[superyacht]] that killed seven people, including billionaire tech magnate [[Mike Lynch (businessman)|Mike Lynch]] in [[Italy]] in 2024, is from being knocked over by extreme wind and could not recover. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/extreme-wind-blamed-for-sinking-of-superyacht-off-sicily-last-year-british-probe-says/ (CTV News)]
*Six people are killed and three injured after an auto-rickshaw and a truck collided head-on in [[Hardoi District]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/six-dead-three-injured-children-auto-truck-collision-accident-2725246-2025-05-15 (India Today)]
*Five people are killed and three others are injured after a van drives into the back of a truck on the [[National road 2 (Poland)|national road 2]] in [[Konotopa, Warsaw West County|Konotopa]], [[Masovian Voivodeship]], [[Poland]]. [https://tvn24.pl/polska/wypadek-na-s2-pod-warszawa-miejscowosc-konotopa-nie-zyje-piec-osob-trzy-ranne-st8461084 (TVN24)]
*Three people, including two firefighters, are killed and two other firefighters are seriously injured in a fire at a former [[Royal Air Force]] base in [[Oxfordshire]], [[England]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cx2r5mrv2n0t (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–United States relations]]
**[[2025 US–Iran negotiations]]
***[[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] says that the [[United States|U.S.]] and [[Iran]] have "sort of" agreed on the terms of a deal on [[nuclear program of Iran|Iran's nuclear program]], which reportedly includes Iran agreeing to give up [[highly enriched uranium]] while keeping lower-grade uranium needed for civilian [[nuclear power]], in exchange for the lifting of [[International sanctions against Iran|sanctions]]. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-qatar-syria-aludeid-air-base-9c868799582685b3a115c6f0c243d606 (AP)]
*[[Myanmar–Vietnam relations]]
**According to the [[Vietnam]]ese [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Vietnam)|foreign ministry]], more than 650 [[Vietnamese people|Vietnamese nationals]] are detained for [[illegal immigration|immigration violations]] in [[Myanmar]]. The Vietnamese [[Ministry of Public Security (Vietnam)|public security ministry]] has [[repatriate]]d 450 people, most are victims of [[scam center]]s, with 200 still in Myanmar. [https://en.vietnamplus.vn/over-450-vietnamese-citizens-repatriated-from-myanmar-foreign-ministry-post319315.vnp (Vietnam+)] [https://vietnamnews.vn/politics-laws/1717736/400-vietnamese-nationals-detained-in-myanmar-over-immigration-regulations.html (''Việt Nam News'')] 
*[[Visa policy of mainland China]]
**At the [[China-CELAC Forum]] in [[Beijing]], the [[China|Chinese]] [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (China)|foreign ministry]] announces it will allow nationals from [[Argentina]], [[Brazil]], [[Chile]], [[Peru]], and [[Uruguay]] to enter the country without a [[travel visa]] starting June 1. [https://apnews.com/article/china-latin-america-visa-free-travel-1b3baa45cbe2b866b8d42900d29949b7 (AP)]
